family_reports.body: The system has did nothing but ruin my life. Try to take my kid or in the middle of trying to take my kid and some false accusations boom.

Safety is when you know you are safe, it's when you know that your parents are safe, it's when you can lay your head down at night and go to bed peacefully it's when you can tell your parents that you love them and give them a hug but once foster care takes you, you never know when you'll be safe again, you don't know when you will be able to lay your head down at night and fall asleep peacefully you don't know if your parents are okay and your biggest worry is your parents and your siblings at the end of the day but you're also so angry because the court took that all away from you.

The hurt is unmeasurable. Total loss of fairness and justice in the court that is supposed to serve and protect the people and children. Instead it's ripping them apart and destroying them. The trauma is coming from the court.
This destroyed my family. I have lost my children. My wife and I dont get a long well. Our married may beyond repair. I miss my babies.
Destroyed my whole family. Can’t see my grandkids grow up! My son in law committed suicide over the removal of his kids!
Destroyed our whole lives. Drove my love to committ suicide. Robbed us of time with my kids!

public_comments.comment_text: Misrepresented me, threatens me, refused to call witness's in a major court proceeding, spoke to the judge about about things I did not know, also things I did not want him to, the. Went on to represent my children in the same case, That is a clear conflict of interest. Also held an ex parte hearing that we never had a court hearing to, and filed for termination of parental rights.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Travis Carr was first my husband's Lawyer in this case for 1 day covering for his actual lawyer, and a few months later he was then my kids 2nd GAL in this case. When it came to termination of rights they finally then decided it was a conflict of interest. This man represented my husband and my children in the same case. How is that fair? It's not.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: He met with us literally once and then lied about everything we said in the court paperwork. He talked to me for maybe 10 to 20 minutes everything that he had written in the paperwork that I said had to at least have been in hours zoom not no [redacted] minutes.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent
